The Function That Refits the Replicates of a Round

Source: R/bootstrap_engine.R
boot_body.Rd

Returns the function of a replicate's position that worker_map() runs. It is built here so that its environment holds only what the refit needs, and that is what a worker process receives.

Usage

boot_body(
  object,
  spec0,
  draw,
  refit,
  method,
  cfg,
  beta0,
  plans,
  ref,
  validate,
  isolate,
  keep_fit
)

Arguments

object, spec0

The fit and its specification.

draw

The function from bootstrap_plan(), whose attributes give the kind of plan and the targets.

refit, method, cfg, beta0

As in bootstrap_refit().

plans

The draws of the round, or a function of the position that returns the draw.

ref

The reading of the fit itself, from boot_read_mode().

validate, isolate, keep_fit

As in bootstrap_engine(), where isolate is stream.

Value

A function of the position of a replicate in plans, returning a list with status, beta, hyper and fit.
